Interface VisibilityRule

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface VisibilityRule
The value of the VISIBILITY behavior — whether an addressable thing is shown, as a client-side predicate rather than a static flag. This is what lets one key cover both "hide this" and "reveal this only while hovered" (the old revealWhen): the rule is re-evaluated each frame in the client dispatch.

Client-only, by contract

VISIBILITY is a CLIENT-tier key and a rule is invoked only on the client, in the render/input dispatch. The server never resolves VISIBILITY for a content or sync decision — a created slot's contents keep syncing whether or not the client is currently showing the slot (hiding is a render decision, not a server state). So a rule may freely read client-only state (hover, config) and must not be relied on server-side. (The engine's per-address store is shared client+server in single-player; honoring "client resolves VISIBILITY" is what keeps a client hide from ever stopping server sync.)
